subject: Post-demo: target $/1M tokens and Q3 budget range — next steps
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: target $/1M tokens and Q3 budget range — next steps

Hi Sarah — thanks again for taking the demo today, and for walking us through the two primary flows (clinical summarization and patient Q&A). Quick recap and the asks we promised to follow up on: 

- Volumes: you mentioned a steady-state of ~25M tokens/month across summarization + Q&A, with a bursty peak of ~80–100M in onboarding weeks. Please confirm if the 25M is conservative or expected baseline.
- Target unit economics: you flagged wanting ~ $900–1,200 per 1M tokens as an internal budget band for Q3. Confirm?
- New route: product asked about adding a vector-search assisted route for Q&A (embedding + retrieval) — need blended rate guidance if we bundle that route with existing generation traffic.
- Procurement path: you said contracts + security will need a short SOW and PO. Ben, can you own a procurement checklist after Sarah confirms numbers?

Attached I’m sending a quick unit-econ workbook (redwood_unit_econ_calc.xlsx) showing blended-rate examples at several volume tiers and how prefix caching affects effective $/1M. Two proposed next steps: (1) Sarah confirms baseline monthly tokens and Q3 budget range, (2) we propose two blended options (conservative vs aggressive) and lock in an MRR commitment level that maps to the blended pricing.

If that sounds right I’ll follow up with proposed pricing math by EOD Monday.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

--
Attachment: redwood_unit_econ_calc.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42 KB)
From: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@lumenhealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@lumenhealth.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 08:03:14 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: target $/1M tokens and Q3 budget range — next steps

Thanks, Aditya — great demo. Quick answers and clarifications: 

- Baseline: 25M/month is accurate for production steady-state; onboarding expected to add ~60–80M across first month for migrating historical transcripts. After month 1, expect step-up to ~35–40M as new clinics onboard.
- Budget band: the finance team is comfortable with $900–$1,100 per 1M tokens for the first 6 months if we can get predictable month-to-month billing and a brief SLA note for latency on summarization routes.
- New route: the vector retrieval route would be used for ~15% of Q&A requests initially — that’s ~3.75–6M tokens/month if baseline stays at 25M. We’d like a blended quote that shows impact if retrieval becomes 30% of traffic.
- Procurement: contracts@lumenhealth.com is on this thread. They will need a short SOW, expected start date 2027-08-01, and a draft MSA redline.

Can you send two blended pricing options (A: flat blended at baseline volumes, B: tiered step-up with a volume commitment) plus the short SOW and the MSA redline guidance? If you can include expected effective $/1M after prefix caching at typical 2–3 turn conversations, that would help.

Best,
Sarah Patel
Head of Product, LumenHealth
sarah.patel@lumenhealth.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:11:02 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: target $/1M tokens and Q3 budget range — next steps

Sarah — perfect, thanks for the clarity. Attached is a short two-option pricing note and the mutual action plan (MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_LumenHealth.docx). Summary here: 

Option A — Baseline blended (assumes 25M tokens/month; retrieval = 15%):
- List price components: generation routes at $0.00135/token equivalent, retrieval route (embedding+tokenized retrieval) at $0.0009/token equivalent.
- Blended math at baseline: effective $/1M tokens = $1,020.
- With conservative prefix caching (20% token savings on summaries): effective $/1M ≈ $820.

Option B — Tiered step-up (commitment bands):
- 25M–49M: $950/1M (blended), 50M–99M: $860/1M, 100M+: $760/1M; blending applied monthly.
- If retrieval share grows to 30%, blended rate improves ~4–7% because embeddings are cheaper and cacheable.
- We show an illustrative month where onboarding pushes to 85M tokens; blended effective $/1M ≈ $890 under tiered discounts.

Ask: can you confirm which option Finance prefers (A or B) and whether you can commit to an MRR target (or a 3‑month rolling commit) so we can lock pricing? If helpful, we can convert these into a 1‑page SOW + PO template for your procurement.

Ben — can you take the procurement/PO template and follow up with DocuSign readiness once Sarah confirms option?

Aditya

--
